# Recovering a Sunk Boat

*Test fixture. This text is invented for automated tests and comes from no published book.*

Every boat sinks once, and the second launch is the one that teaches.

## Lift, drain, and dry

Lift the boat by its keel fold and never by the brim. Let it drain bow down, then dry it flat under a book.

> A boat that dries flat will fold again. A boat that dries crumpled is a paper ball.

## Fold it again

Refold along the old creases as described in [Folding the Hull](01-folding-the-hull.md). Old creases remember their shape, and new ones weaken the sheet.
